standing_rules_that_bite: SOP-021 fact 10: ASDA's saved per-product quantity survives a full reload and silently overrides the list. Set EVERY quantity with the +/- steppers. Typed quantities do not persist server-side. This is the most expensive recorded lesson in the build.
Rule 38: a failed add almost always means OUT OF STOCK, not a slot problem. Drop it and flag it. Never substitute.
Rule 36: where a multibuy gives 50% or more off the extra item(s), buy up to the offer quantity. Most likely on Lucozade, Yazoo and the ice creams.
Rule 35: at View Trolley, 'Allow substitutions for all' must be UNTICKED before handover.
Rule 10: milk is Cravendale Arla, never Best-of-Both.
Never auto-substitute. A materially different product is a REPORTED ambiguity, never a silent swap.
